scientific_integrity: The all-parameter proof uses exact characteristic polynomials and Perron monotonicity, not only numerical evidence. The rational biological-feasibility example has separate exclusive juvenile survival and maturation probabilities. Historical priority has not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Two stages, exactly two alternating seasons, strictly positive vital-rate matrix entries, fixed season-specific juvenile and adult stasis, deterministic linear expected-abundance model. The switch need not persist for other matrix structures, more seasons, density dependence or nonlinear extinction risk.
title: A sharp seasonal-stasis boundary for the phase advantage in a juvenile–adult population
